As expected, the Omni Group spent the entire summer working to ensure all of its applications were ready on day one for Apple's 2027 system update. Here's what was included in the update.

Omni Group updates app suite for Apple's 2027 system launch

Omni Group CEO Ken Case shared in a blog post titled "Hey Siri, We're Ready!" that the development teams behind OmniGraffle, OmniOutliner, OmniPlan, and OmniFocus have been working tirelessly to ensure all of the company's apps are "fully prepared and compatible with all of Apple's platform updates."

Here's what Case shared:

The highlight of this update is OmniFocus 4.9, which is fully compatible with macOS 27 Golden Gate, iOS 27, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The new version adds Siri AI support, an optional date parsing feature powered by Apple Intelligence, "a range of new and updated App Intents presented as Shortcuts actions," as well as design improvements to better align with Apple's 2027 system update.

OmniFocus users can now use Siri to assign and edit due dates, tags, notes, and even recurring schedules. The app also supports additional Siri AI features, such as on-screen content awareness and Visual Intelligence, helping users add content to OmniFocus more quickly.

Siri AI can now also leverage a user's personal data—in practice, this means it can answer questions, summarize action items, suggest next steps, and convert follow-up items from meeting notes into reminders based on the user's OmniFocus database.

Other updates from Omni Group this week include:

  • OmniOutliner 6.3 also incorporates Liquid Glass design improvements across Apple's various platforms.
  • OmniFocus and OmniOutliner now include a new API that allows users and tools to search the Omni Automation API, theoretically making it easier to find necessary documentation when writing scripts.
  • Omni Group stated that this work is also part of their implementation of the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Finally, Case also mentioned that following last week's announcement of the iPhone Duo, the team has already begun preparing their applications for the launch of this foldable device.
